name: Aztech Global Ltd.
summary: Aztech Global Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, design, engineering, manufacture, and sale of IoT devices, data-communication products, LED lighting, and other electrical products. It provides original equipment manufacturing, original design manufacturing, joint development manufacturing, and contract manufacturing services, as well as distributes IoT devices and data-communication products under the Aztech and Kyla brand names. The company also offers LED lighting products for residential, commercial, and industrial applications; and designs and develops smart lighting systems.
